title: Two-colour overpartitions: exact certificates and parameter families
description: Unrefereed two-paper mathematical collection: four exact eta-quotient/Sturm certificates, an exact modulo-8 parameter classification, a modulo-16 binary-form support theorem for square/twice-square parameters, and a dyadic modulo-16 family whenever the parameter odd part is 1 modulo 8. Includes corrected earlier-statement attribution, explicit sharpness and boundary witnesses, and failure-sensitive verification. Universal conclusions require the written proofs. No formal verification, external peer review, independent reproduction, priority certification or world-leading significance is asserted.
